offline_capture: Yes. Technicians work in locations with no signal. Offline capture with sync on reconnect is required.
mobile_vs_desktop: Mobile first. Technicians use phones in the field. Desktop is secondary.
auth_method: Email and password for the pilot. Microsoft login is the target but not required for MVP.
checklist_template_mvp: Hardcoded checklist is fine for the pilot. Template management can come later.
pdf_export: HTML report view is acceptable for MVP. PDF export is a nice-to-have.
default: Use the simpler option that unblocks the pilot team fastest.
